next.reason: 1985 requires at compile time that the subscript data-name-2 'must be a numeric elementary item representing an integer'. In 2023 a subscript is arithmetic-expression-1 (§2023:8.4.2.3.2), whose identifiers need only reference a numeric data item (uncataloged §2023:8.8.1.1, 'an identifier referencing a numeric data item'), qualified as needed. A non-integer is no longer refused: §2023:8.4.2.3.4 GR1 says 'does not result in an integer, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist'. A compile-time refusal became a run-time exception condition (error mode c). Integer subscripts in conforming 1985 programs behave the same.
